# JumpTarget { #timetoalign.timelines.JumpTarget }

```python
timelines.JumpTarget(
    coordinate,
    *,
    id=None,
    _minted=False,
    _unknown_keys=dict[str, Any](),
    name=None,
    label=None,
    meta=dict[str, Any](),
    provenance=None,
    manifestation=None,
)
```

A place a destination names: a repeat start, a segno, a coda, a bracket.

Nothing happens when the flow plays up to it.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name          | Type                                                                                    | Description                                                                                   |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| coordinate    | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)                                             | The place.                                                                                    |
| manifestation | [FlowManifestation](`timetoalign.core.enums.FlowManifestation`) \| [str](`str`) \| None | ``repeat_start``, ``segno``, ``coda``, ``volta``, ``ossia`` or a word outside the vocabulary. |
| name          | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                    | A display name, such as the source's name of the sign.                                        |
| label         | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                    | A human-readable label.                                                                       |
| meta          | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]                                     | Additional metadata.                                                                          |
| provenance    | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`), ...\] \| None | How the element was made and who believes it: provenance entries, or None.                    |
| id            | [str](`str`)                                                                            | The element's ID; minted as ``jump_target_{N}`` when not given.                               |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.core import Coordinate, TimeUnit
>>> JumpTarget(Coordinate(16, TimeUnit.quarters), manifestation="segno")
JumpTarget('jump_target_1', segno @ 16 quarters)
```
